description: We are an interdisciplinary team passionate about leveraging technology and scientific data to solve real-world challenges. Our interests span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data analytics, and software development. Combining diverse technical perspectives, we aim to develop innovative, scalable, and data-driven solutions through collaborative problem-solving and interdisciplinary expertise.
summary:
Farming decisions should be guided by the land, the soil, and the changing climate. Kisaan Sahayak (The Farmer's Assistant) is an AI-powered farming assistant that brings these elements together to support more sustainable and climate-resilient agriculture.

Farmers can register their farm using GPS or manual location search, explore soil information, record soil test results, and receive personalised crop and seasonal recommendations. The platform provides crop rotation guidance, weather-based advisories, and an AI-powered voice assistant that answers agricultural questions and makes farming information easier to understand.

By combining farm-specific data, soil health insights, climate awareness, and AI-powered assistance in one platform, Kisaan Sahayak helps farmers make informed decisions about what to grow and when. Its goal is to reduce guesswork, protect long-term soil fertility, encourage sustainable agricultural practices, and strengthen farming communities against climate-related challenges.
details:
Project Overview

Kisaan Sahayak is an AI-powered agricultural advisory platform that helps Indian farmers make climate-informed farming decisions using farm-specific soil, weather, and climate data.

Key Features

  • Farm Registration: GPS-based and manual farm location registration.
  • Climate Intelligence: NASA POWER historical climate data and Open-Meteo weather forecasts.
  • Soil Analysis: Soil properties through ISRIC SoilGrids and manually entered soil test results.
  • Crop Recommendations: Rule-based suitability scoring for 16 crops based on soil, temperature, rainfall, nutrients, regional suitability, and sowing season.
  • Weather Alerts: Warnings and suggested actions for heatwaves, heavy rainfall, frost, drought, and irrigation needs.
  • Farming Guidance: Crop-specific sowing, irrigation, harvesting, and fertiliser planning.
  • AI Voice Assistant: Multilingual agricultural assistance using an AI model, speech recognition, and text-to-speech.

Technology Used

React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, OpenAI API, NASA POWER API, Open-Meteo, ISRIC SoilGrids, OpenStreetMap, and Web Speech API.

Innovation and Impact

Kisaan Sahayak combines multiple agricultural data sources into one accessible platform. Its transparent crop-scoring system explains recommendations, risks, and confidence levels instead of simply suggesting crops.

The project aims to reduce guesswork, encourage sustainable crop rotation, improve soil management, and help farmers adapt to changing climate conditions.
